title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: A practical look at named cadet-area places used for studying, meals, activities, performances, and daily formations.

cards.title: McDermott Library
cards.subtitle: Cadet Area research and reading library
cards.notes: Use its reference, research, and reading collections for coursework; cadet, faculty, and staff access is restricted, so arrange an escort if eligible.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic library with research collections and special collections.
cards.evidence_claim: McDermott Library is in the cadet area and provides reference, research, and reading collections; access is restricted to Academy cadets, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: McDermott Library | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Academy cadets, faculty, and staff; escorted visits may be arranged through Administrative Offices.

cards.title: Arnold Hall
cards.subtitle: Cadet Wing social center
cards.notes: Check the theater, ballroom, displays, lounges, and recreation areas when base access permits; it is a useful indoor meeting point near the Cadet Area.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose social and event building west of the Cadet Area.
cards.evidence_claim: Arnold Hall is the social center for the cadet wing and contains a theater, ballroom, food court, coffee shop, meeting rooms, and recreation facilities.
cards.source_title: Arnold Hall | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Open to the public except under base restrictions.

cards.title: Richter Lounge Food Court
cards.subtitle: Inside Arnold Hall
cards.notes: Meet at a table for a coffee, snack, or conversation, then check the monitors for campus information; food and drinks require a purchase.
cards.short_summary: Arnold Hall’s food-court lounge offers tables and large-screen monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Richter Lounge Food Court has food options, tables, and large-screen monitors, and the Academy describes it as a place for conversation, coffee, or lunch.
cards.source_title: Arnold Hall | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located north of the Arnold Hall Theater; the official page says it is available to the public subject to base restrictions.

cards.title: Mitchell Hall
cards.subtitle: Cadet dining facility
cards.notes: Plan around the cadet meal schedule: weekday breakfast and noon meals are required during the academic year, with buffet meals at other times.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s principal cadet dining facility and shared meal setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Mitchell Hall is the cadet dining hall, where more than 4,000 cadets assemble for family-style noon meals during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Cadet dining facility; visitor access and meal availability should be confirmed with the Academy.

cards.title: Fairchild Hall
cards.subtitle: Academic building in the Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the Falcon Center between classes for a meal or a meetup, and keep the academic schedule in mind because most classes and labs are located here.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with casual on-base dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Most Academy academic classes and labs are located in Fairchild Hall, and the Falcon Center is presented as a place to meet friends for lunch between classes.
cards.source_title: Dormitories & Dining | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located in the Cadet Area; follow base and building access rules.

cards.title: The Terrazzo
cards.subtitle: Cadet Area parade and circulation space
cards.notes: Watch the noon meal formation from the Honor Court wall, then follow the Cadet Wing’s route across the Terrazzo toward Mitchell Hall.
cards.short_summary: The shared outdoor space crossed during the daily noon meal formation.
cards.evidence_claim: At 1130, the Cadet Wing lines up by squadron in front of Vandenberg Hall and marches across The Terrazzo to Mitchell Hall for lunch.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Viewable from the Honor Court wall for Academy visitors; follow posted base access rules.

cards.title: Honor Court
cards.subtitle: Overlooking the Terrazzo
cards.notes: Use the Honor Court wall as the designated visitor vantage point for observing the Cadet Wing’s noon meal formation across the Terrazzo.
cards.short_summary: A named viewing point for a daily Academy formation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Academy says visitors can watch noon meal formation from the Honor Court wall overlooking the Terrazzo.
cards.source_title: Day in the Life | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Follow visitor and base-access rules when viewing the formation.

cards.title: U.S. Air Force Academy Planetarium
cards.subtitle: 2120 Cadet Drive
cards.notes: Arrive early for a first-come, first-served public show; no ticket or reservation is required, but weather or cadet education can cancel a show.
cards.short_summary: A 110-seat digital dome used for cadet education and community shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Planetarium offers free public shows on a first-come, first-served basis, with no tickets or reservations required.
cards.source_title: Self-Guided Tour | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Closed weekends, graduation day, and federal holidays; shows may be cancelled without notice for weather or cadet education.

cards.title: Cadet Field House
cards.subtitle: 2169 Field House Drive
cards.notes: Check the athletics schedule or event entry rules before going; the building groups an indoor track, basketball arena, and ice rink in one named facility.
cards.short_summary: A large multipurpose athletics building serving intercollegiate and intramural activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cadet Field House houses the indoor track, basketball arena, and ice hockey rink and supports numerous intercollegiate, practice, and intramural uses.
cards.source_title: Parents' Weekend | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Entry policies apply for events; people and belongings entering the venue may be subject to search.

cards.title: Core Values Ramp
cards.subtitle: Between Vandenberg Hall and Fairchild Hall
cards.notes: Pause at the ramp while walking the Cadet Area: it is the route new cadets ascend on in-processing day as their Academy transition begins.
cards.short_summary: A named Cadet Area ramp associated with the first day for new cadets.
cards.evidence_claim: The Core Values Ramp leads from the main Terrazzo toward the parade field, and new cadets ascend it on in-processing day to begin their Academy transition.
cards.source_title: Cadet Wing Parade | United States Air Force Academy
cards.access_notes: Located between Vandenberg Hall and Fairchild Hall; respect Cadet Area access controls and active formations.
